comments:
According to <<van der Kuijp 2003 [FZ6N88AU]>> this instance corresponds to the Beijing Cultural Palace of Nationalities catalogue no. 004323(9). According to <<Kramer 2007 [Q47PVAE6]>>: 16, n. 4, the copy in [Z5AUD7GQ] appears to be a second exemplar with identical length and title as the Beijing CPN copy (non-accessible).
The images in [Z5AUD7GQ] and in [WL4AE7U6] are of the same manuscript ([BAQ9MH4T]: 206, n. 27).

item_description:
Script: dbu can.
Lines per folio: 6; 7 on fol. 86, 5 on fol. 9a.
Orthography:
- Occasional abbreviations (e.g., for so sor, 'phul lo, gnyis su, las kyi)
- Bindu used a few times for final –m
A few short insertions (corrections). Long insertion of a missing passage in the bottom margin on fol. 5a.
Proofread once.
Indigenous catalogue marking: 3(9?)8 on cover page.
